verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents that merchants submit order, payment and transaction details through the Checkout and Sale APIs for fraud review. It also offers a device-profiling script for the checkout page and mobile SDKs, so some merchant-side signals do reach its scoring. Nothing shows a developer supplying their own fingerprints, behavioral data or arbitrary custom fields to shape the model, and Decision Center policies are rule configuration, not signal input. Missing for 10: documented custom-metadata or custom-field submission, merchant-supplied device fingerprint and behavioral data fields, evidence that submitted signals change model scoring per merchant, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed the model my own signals — device fingerprints, behavioral data, custom metadata — so scoring reflects my business, not just network defaults

citations.quote: Place the following script just before the closing `</head>` tag on your checkout page.
use the Checkout API to submit the order and payment details to Signifyd for fraud review
use the Sale API to submit the order and transaction details to Signifyd for fraud review
SDKs provide mobile application developers with self-contained libraries for implementing Signifyd.
